## Missing-data report

**Dataset:** 344 rows × 8 columns (pinned public penguins CSV)

| Column | Missing cells |
|---|---|
| species | 0 |
| island | 0 |
| bill_length_mm | 2 |
| bill_depth_mm | 2 |
| flipper_length_mm | 2 |
| body_mass_g | 2 |
| sex | 11 |
| year | 0 |
| **Total** | **19** |

**Rows with at least one missing value:** 11

**Observations:**
- `sex` is the only column with a notable gap (11 missing), which exactly accounts for all 11 affected rows.
- The four measurement columns each show 2 missing cells. Column-level counts do not tell us whether those cells fall in the same rows or in different rows, so I can't state how many distinct rows carry missing measurements.
- `species`, `island`, and `year` are complete.

**Checks not performed:** No schema/profile, duplicate, numeric-range, or category checks were run, per your instruction to report only missing-data counts. Consequently, I have no evidence about non-finite numeric representations or out-of-category values, and no basis for assessing whether the 2-cell measurement gaps are overlap or independent.

**Limitations:** Counts are non-destructive aggregates. I made no changes to the dataset, and the missing counts alone do not indicate why the values are absent or whether the affected records are usable for downstream analysis.
